findings.body: The new test exercises creation, listing, and rendering directly, bypassing the required running API and Playwright user flow. Its valid-snapshot assertions also pass with the deleted fallbacks restored, so it does not guard this fix. Existing CLI coverage mocks the API at apps/core/test/unit/cli/memory-review-command.test.ts:15. Add regression-sensitive coverage through the required real entry points and include it in the repository test command; package.json:86 currently runs only unit and integration suites.
findings.title: Not done: End-to-end coverage for required memory review snapshots

findings.body: Both tests exercising envelope-less typing events are deleted without replacement coverage for the changed behavior. Remaining transport coverage supplies orderedEnvelope and mocks the stream (apps/core/test/unit/control/sdk-transport.test.ts:644 and :662), so restoring the legacy acceptance branch would escape detection. Add coverage through actual SDK consumption using the required API/database/browser flow, asserting that an envelope-less typing event cannot establish typing state before an ordered baseline exists, and run it in the repository suite.

why: Two leftover code paths support data shapes the product no longer produces: memory reviews without a snapshot, and SDK typing events without ordering info
